He made the people follow the proper path, and ousted the enemy from @wGN{Sumer}. He removed the wicked tongues, and made justice shine forth like copper. That fathers should be feared and mothers respected, that sons should pay heed to the words of their fathers, and that mercy, compassion and pity should be shown, that one should provide even one's paternal grandparents with food and drink -- all this he established in @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad}. Then she made @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}, the son of @wDN{Enlil}, the @fsux{en} priest of @wSN{Unug}, into their guardian -- this is what @wDN{Inana}, the lady of heaven and earth, did; and the great @wDN{An} declared his consent. @wDN{Enlil} …….
